title: Let’s talk about what’s changed since first preview and if my thought...
transcript: So I saw Sweeney Todd again… So I've been lucky enough to see this show 3 times now and I want to update my thoughts because I haven't really talked about it on here since I saw first preview and a lot of things have changed! One thing that did not change is they did not add the whistle back in and they did not add more blood and I am disappointed on both accounts! I really think cutting the whistle from the orchestrations was a big mistake. And as for the blood, I know that some of this is just personal preference, but I just did not find the death to be bloody enough. You just kind of get a little trickle of blood down the smock and I wanted it to feel visceral, I wanted them to feel like they had weight to them, I wanted blood squirting out the neck like and you just you just don't get that, and because of that for me a lot of the death scenes fall flat. But there are parts of this production that did get a lot better. One of those areas was the lighting, which I remember first preview feeling was a bit lacking, and when it won the Tony I was a little confused, Like, really? Like, it was Sweeney won the lighting Tony? It just didn't really make sense. But having been revisited 2 more times, the lighting got so much stronger. They added a bunch more lighting cues and I think there's some really really effective moments of lighting. So I honestly really do think it was a deserved Tony win! I also think the staging overall got a lot tighter, particularly with the way that it integrates the dancing into the scenes. I still think that this production over uses its dancing, but I did find it overall to be much better integrated into the staging. There's one bit of staging that did really bother me, the second time I saw the show. Because I was on the left side of the theater, and a lot of Joanna scenes are up on a platform and all the way on the left. And so me and the people that I was with had a hard time seeing what was going on because of the sight lines in the theater. So definitely be advised if you are going to see the show I would recommend sitting on the right side of the house so that you can see what's going on in those scenes. Because if you are on the left 3rd of the theater you may have a hard time. I also want to call out 2 performances that I don't see get enough love, one being Maria Bilbao as Johanna. I think she is fantastic! I love the mannerisms and quirks that she gives the character, and her performance has only gotten stronger every time I see her. I am really really impressed by her, and her voice is gorgeous! The other is Nic Christopher as Pirelli, and I just love the accent that he gives this character, both as Perelli and then as Daniel O’Higgins. I think it is so funny, all of the choices that he makes are over the top, and just make me laugh so much. For me he is the comedic standout of the show! As for our 2 leads, I think that they're both really good but not amazing. I was really high on Annaleigh’s Lovett the first time I saw it, but then the second time I went back I had Jeanna on as Lovett, and I kind of liked her better… Now I could do a whole video on why I loved Jeanna’s Lovett so much, and I still think Annaleigh’s Lovett is really good, and her comedy chops are second to none, but watching her that 3rd visit just made me miss a lot of the choices that Jeanna had made. As for Josh’s Sweeney, I think his voice is absolutely gorgeous, and I love every time I get to hear him sing the score… I just don't find his Sweeney super menacing. And I've kind of come to accept that, and appreciate Josha Sweeney for what it is, but it wouldn't have been my first choice for Sweeney.
